entries.name: Seahorse Valley
entries.description: The cleft between the main cardioid and the period-2 bulb, lined with curled seahorse tails.

entries.name: Seahorse
entries.description: A single seahorse from the valley: a double spiral whose arms repeat the whole pattern.

entries.name: Elephant Valley
entries.description: The eastern edge of the main cardioid near its cusp, where spirals resemble rows of elephant trunks.

entries.name: Spiral Zoom Target
entries.description: The center of a widely shared Mandelbrot zoom animation near Seahorse Valley, magnified about 24 billion times with a raised iteration limit.

entries.name: Branch Point at c = i (Deep Zoom)
entries.description: The preperiodic point c = i magnified 10^24 times. Branches keep repeating at every depth; this view uses high-precision rendering.

entries.name: Dragon Spiral
entries.description: A spiral arm of the Julia set for c = -0.8 + 0.156i, the default Julia constant.

entries.name: Douady Rabbit
entries.description: The Julia set for the center of the period-3 bulb. Its interior regions meet three at a time, like ears and a head.

entries.name: San Marco Dragon
entries.description: The Julia set for c = -0.75: a chain of bulbs along the real axis, named after the domes of St Mark's Basilica.

entries.name: Dendrite
entries.description: For c = i the Julia set has no interior: it is a branching tree that encloses no area.

entries.name: Dendrite Branch Point (Deep Zoom)
entries.description: The point z = i of the dendrite magnified 10^20 times. The same branching reappears at every depth; this view uses high-precision rendering.

entries.name: Right Cusp
entries.description: One of the two cusps of the cubic Multibrot's main body, on the positive real axis.

entries.name: Upper Period-2 Island
entries.description: The bulb around c = i, whose critical orbit alternates between 0 and i.

entries.name: Junction Valley
entries.description: The narrow cleft where the period-2 bulb touches the main body near c = 0.77i, fringed with fine filaments.

entries.name: Little Ship
entries.description: The best-known Burning Ship detail: a smaller ship with masts and rigging on the antenna near -1.75.

entries.name: Ship Detail
entries.description: A closer look at the little ship's hull and masts.

entries.name: Coastal Ridges
entries.description: Jagged, angular ridges along the edge of the main ship, produced by the absolute values in the Burning Ship formula.

entries.name: Western Branch
entries.description: The branch extending west from the Tricorn body along the real axis.

entries.name: Western Miniature
entries.description: A small three-cornered copy of the Tricorn on its western branch.

entries.name: Off-axis Branch
entries.description: A branch above the real axis where the Tricorn's characteristic wavy edges are clearest.
